Your Moon is in Pisces, meaning you pick up what everyone around you is feeling whether you want to or not, and you only find your own feelings once you're alone. This is learned behavior. If the feelings in your house growing up were bigger than anyone explained, you learned to sense what was coming before it arrived, and tuning into people became automatic. Looking after whoever was struggling most became your job before anyone asked. You still need time away from the noise, because without it other people's moods pile up in you and stop feeling like theirs. When you're upset, you drift, out of the conversation, into daydreams, anywhere softer than here.

Their Moon is in Sagittarius, meaning they feel better the moment they get out, and a bad mood with nowhere to go turns into a cage fast. This is learned behavior. If the people around them growing up were free spirits, or if home felt small, they learned that leaving worked, and that a joke, a trip, or a bigger perspective could beat sitting in the feeling. They still need something to look forward to, because a life with nothing on the horizon starts to feel like a dead end. When they're upset, or when someone leans on them too hard, they make it funny, make it a story, or make plans, anything but admit it.

Your Moon in Pisces and {friend}'s Moon in Sagittarius are water and fire, both mutable, so you drown in the heavy feeling that {friend} runs from. You share a dreamer's streak, and together you can go somewhere genuinely magical. But watch the loop when it goes wrong: the more {friend} bolts, the deeper you sink, and the deeper you sink, the more deserted you feel and the faster {friend} goes. You aren't trying to pull anyone under, and {friend} isn't deserting you. You're both doing the thing that used to work.
